summary: Polaryx Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement of 2,502,696 shares (5.3% of outstanding) to ~35 investors, raising $10 million at a weighted average price of ~$4.00 per share. The per-share price ranged from $3.70 to $4.10 depending on investment amount. MStone Partners Healthcare, the largest stockholder, purchased $360,000 worth of shares. Proceeds will fund the SOTERIA Phase 2 basket trial and general corporate purposes. The offering closed May 28, 2026, and was exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S. This is a routine capital raise, not a transformative special situation.
